mapper.select: select d.*,COALESCE(f.sales,0) as sales FROM dish as d LEFT JOIN (select od.dish_id,sum(od.number)as sales from orders as o LEFT JOIN order_detail as od on o.id=od.order_id WHERE o.order_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) and o.`status`=5 GROUP BY od.dish_id)as f ON d.id=f.dish_id where d.category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dish (name, category_id, price,image,description, status,create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price},#{image},#{description}, #{status},#{createUser},#{updateUser})
mapper.update:
UPDATE dish
name = #{name},
category_id = #{categoryId},
price = #{price},
image = #{image},
description = #{description},
status = #{status},
update_user = #{updateUser},
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.category_id, d.price, d.image, d.description, d.status, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(od_all.number) FROM order_detail od_all INNER JOIN orders o_all ON od_all.order_id = o_all.id WHERE od_all.dish_id = d.id AND o_all.status = #{status} AND o_all.order_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ), 0) AS sales FROM dish d ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.category_id, d.price, d.image, d.description, d.status, COUNT(od2.dish_id) AS score, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(od_all.number) FROM order_detail od_all INNER JOIN orders o_all ON od_all.order_id = o_all.id WHERE od_all.dish_id = d.id AND o_all.status = #{status} AND o_all.order_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ), 0) AS sales -- 全平台总销量 FROM dish d INNER JOIN order_detail od2 ON d.id = od2.dish_id INNER JOIN orders o2 ON od2.order_id = o2.id WHERE o2.user_id IN ( -- 相似用户 SELECT DISTINCT o.user_id FROM order_detail od INNER JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id WHERE od.dish_id IN ( SELECT od3.dish_id FROM order_detail od3 INNER JOIN orders o3 ON od3.order_id = o3.id WHERE o3.user_id = #{userId} AND o3.status = #{status} GROUP BY od3.dish_id ) AND o.user_id != #{userId} AND o.status = #{status} ) GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY COUNT(od2.dish_id) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
